method: Existing native_performance_baseline.sh sources compiled once per immutable snapshot; unchanged native harness run sequentially in balanced orders. Controlled 0 and 1 were interrupted by other desktop activity. Controlled 2 and 3 had no concurrent compiler or UI test. Comparison runs follow recompilation of PR360 and the final selection guard. Background desktop CPU load remained variable. All samples retained.

runs.scope: Seeded native MainView, text-only synthetic articles, offline. Time to first sampled bitmap containing the title; includes prior failed capture/OCR polls but excludes successful OCR. Memory includes setup, SwiftUI and Vision. Not cold app launch, live network, or model timing.
